title: Verification accepts Spanish generated blocks: I13 skips generated blocks and I16, I2, I4 and block structure do not compare them with the English text
finding: Decision (user, iteration 378): generated blocks in the Spanish edition equal the generator output with BOOK_LANG=es, which is Spanish. `build.py --check` already compares them with the generator, so invariant I13 (i13_text, the 'generated block ... differs' finding) must skip generated blocks, and the other checks that failed after regeneration on 19 files (I16 expected text, I4 link destinations, I2 tokens, 'block structure differs (1 -> 258 blocks)' on lessons/indice.md) must treat generated block content as owned by the generator. Add a narrow negative test or fixture: a hand-edited generated block must still be caught by build.py --check, and an edited code block next to a generated block must still fail I13. Do NOT run build.py --generate or commit regenerated lesson files in this task: that is P5-001. Prove the change by regenerating in a scratch copy of the tree, running verify --fast there, and showing the result.
accept: python3 -I tools/test_invariants.py && python3 -I tools/test_negative.py && python3 -I tools/verify.py --fast
notes: I13 skips generated blocks and files; segment.strip_generated (both GENERATED by / GENERADO por markers) used by check_files and verify.check_file (I16, I2, I4, structure). Proved in-tree: BOOK_LANG=es regenerate -> verify --fast OK (23 checks); hand-edited generated block -> build.py --check STALE; code beside a generated block still fails I13/I4. Regenerated files reverted (P5-001).
